{{Short description|Type of geometrical tiling}}
{{Uniform hyperbolic tiles db|Uniform hyperbolic tiling stat table|U65_1}}
In [[geometry]], the '''pentahexagonal tiling''' is a [[Uniform tilings in hyperbolic plane|uniform]] tiling of the [[Hyperbolic geometry|hyperbolic plane]]. It has [[Schläfli symbol]] of r{6,5} or t<sub>1</sub>{6,5}.
